newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly down, gains in blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly down, gains in blue chips.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly down on Friday on a higher volume with new gains in blue chips.
* Of 11 active issues six were down, three were up and two stayed flat.
* Volume up at 14,025, turnover lower at 5.3 million kuna.
* Biggest loser was chocolate maker Kras, 40 kuna down to 619 with 619 units sold.
* Biggest gainer was drugs firm Pliva, 35 kuna up to 450. It was also most actively traded issue with 8,257 shares sold. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
